assumption.matching_benchmark: Based on repeated measurements of the same configuration and workload.
assumption.analytical: The pre-launch estimate uses a range of GPU compute and memory bandwidth efficiencies.
assumption.kv_unverified: Available KV cache has not been confirmed by an engine startup.
assumption.scheduler_capped: The estimate applies the engine’s concurrency limit.
assumption.prefix_reuse: The range includes scenarios with cold and reused shared input.
assumption.prefix_disabled: Prefix caching is disabled, so each request processes its full input.
assumption.moe_routing: The estimate accounts for active experts and expert weights accessed per batch.
assumption.kimi_mla_dcp: For this ROCm recipe, target and draft MLA caches span eight DCP ranks. KDA state is accounted per TP rank and communication time is estimated from the MI355X links. Startup profiling is needed to confirm allocatable KV tokens.
assumption.draft_traffic_only: This draft estimate includes known weight transfers. Its compute and cache read times need additional evidence.
assumption.public_model_spec: This estimate uses the published model geometry and weight manifest for the selected revision.
assumption.draft_revision_assumed: The unpinned draft model was estimated at the public revision linked below.
assumption.speculation: The range includes the cost when every proposed token is rejected or accepted. Actual acceptance depends on the workload.
assumption.host_kv_transfer_unmeasured: Transfers and hits in the CPU KV cache require measurement. The warm estimate assumes a GPU cache hit.
assumption.weight_offload_unmeasured: The actual offloaded weight size and host-to-GPU bandwidth require a running engine.
assumption.offload: Moving data between CPU and GPU affects throughput.
assumption.parallelism: The estimate accounts for sharding and communication between GPUs.
assumption.attention_approx: Attention and cache access costs are approximated from the model architecture.
assumption.deepseek_compression: DeepSeek-V4 layers with 4× compression scan the index and fetch top-ranked entries. Layers with 128× compression attend to the full compressed context.
assumption.weight_approx: The estimated weight traffic uses the checkpoint shard inventory and weight precision.
assumption.runtime_fp8: The range accounts for weights converted to FP8 at startup and for embeddings and scales that may retain their original precision.
assumption.pd_transfer: The estimate splits concurrency between the prefill and decode pools and assumes 100–400 Gbit/s of bandwidth for KV transfers.

guide.title: Getting started
guide.subtitle: From joining a team to tracking your spend — everything you need for your first call.
guide.step1Title: Join a team & issue an API key
guide.step1Body: All usage and budgets are managed per team. Join a team first, then create an API key that belongs to it.
guide.step1Item1: Find your team in Discover Teams and request to join.
guide.step1Item2: Once approved, create a key from My Keys.
guide.step1Note: The key value is shown only once at creation — store it somewhere safe.
guide.step2Body: The gateway speaks the OpenAI-compatible API: point your existing SDK or HTTP client at the gateway base URL and use your key.
guide.step2Note: Replace <gateway-host> with your environment's gateway address and <model-name> with a model from the catalog.
guide.step3Title: Pick a model from the catalog
guide.step3Body: The catalog shows what's available, what it costs, and when it changes. The catalog model name is exactly what you pass as the model parameter.
guide.step3Item1: Model Calendar — availability and schedule changes.
guide.step3Item2: Model Dashboard — pricing (input / output / cache read) and specs.
guide.step4Body: Your team page's Usage tab shows requests, tokens, and spend for every member.
guide.step4Item1: Input (cache rd) — input tokens, with the cache-read portion in parentheses; a bigger parenthetical means cheaper input.

warn.subpath_dropped: PVC mount used subPath, which the recipe cannot express:

warn.relocated_flags: Flags without a dedicated field were moved to extra args:

servingRecipes.runtimeExtraPortsHint: One name=port per line (e.g. metrics=9100), declared as TCP ports on the serving container. Names are up to 15 lower-case letters, digits or -; http and nixl are reserved. --kv-events-config ports are added automatically.
servingRecipes.runtimeRolloutHint: New pod first: one replica's worth of GPUs must be free during the rollout. Old pod first: no extra GPUs, but capacity drops by one replica meanwhile, and a deployment with one replica is refused because that would be an outage.
servingRecipes.runtimeGracefulHint: On shutdown the pod waits the preStop sleep before SIGTERM, then gets the grace period to finish in-flight requests. Defaults 120 s / 10 s.
servingRecipes.kvEventsHint: vLLM publishes an event over ZMQ whenever a KV cache block is stored or evicted (--kv-events-config). The llm-d router's precise prefix-cache routing subscribes to them. Match the KV block size in the engine args to the router's block size.
servingRecipes.kvEventsVllmOnly: KV events are vLLM-only. Turn them off to save with this engine.
servingRecipes.kvEventsEndpointHint: The ZMQ PUB socket. With a wildcard host such as tcp://*:<port> it binds on the pod and a kv-events container port is declared. Blank = tcp://*:5556.
servingRecipes.kvEventsReplayHint: Socket subscribers use to fetch events they missed (kv-replay port). Blank = not opened.
servingRecipes.kvEventsTopicHint: Blank = filled in at deploy time as kv@$(POD_IP):<port the router reaches>@<served model name>, so every deployment of a shared recipe gets its own; the portal adds a POD_IP env var when missing.

portalModels.credentialHint: Existing credentials are never displayed. Blank keys and unspecified settings are preserved. Manage base pricing in LiteLLM.
portalModels.providerOptionsHint: Enter only settings to change. Stored secret values are never loaded.
portalModels.apiBaseHint: Both http:// and https:// are supported. Include the full base path, such as /v1. Saves update this LiteLLM connection and its serving registration while keeping the connection ID and running Pods.

portalTeams.title: Teams
portalTeams.accessHint: Changes model invocation grants only. Serving and inherited group grants remain. Inherited grants can allow calls even without direct grants.
portalTeams.inheritedHint: Inherited from LiteLLM unified access groups, whose membership is managed in LiteLLM.
portalTeams.noneEffective: No registered model is currently allowed.

teamVisibility.title: Visibility
teamVisibility.hint: Hide teams from discovery, or also hide them from members’ team and key lists.
teamVisibility.loadError: Could not load team visibility settings.

benchmarkSimple.scenarioHint: Search and document analysis · 3 fixed turns. Question → search results → document content. Tools are not executed; recorded history, rather than generated answers, supplies the next turn.
benchmarkSimple.ratioHint: The shared portion of input, not the observed cache hit rate.
benchmarkSimple.presetSaveHint: Manage shared presets. Saving does not change existing runs or current inputs.
benchmarkSimple.deleteDefaultHint: Select another default before deleting the default preset.
benchmarkSimple.accuracyHistory: Accuracy evaluation is available as historical results only.
benchmarkSimple.warmupExcluded: Warmup and prefix preparation are excluded from measurement.
benchmarkSimple.actualTokensHint: Actual chat input includes server templates and re-tokenization. Results use server-reported usage.
benchmarkSimple.turnRateHint: Per-turn throughput uses the interval from that turn's first request to its last completion. Overall throughput uses the entire measurement interval, not an average of turn rates.
benchmarkSimple.endpointHint: Enter an OpenAI-compatible API URL and key. Internal serving, LiteLLM and external APIs use the same runner. A single model is selected automatically; choose when multiple models are available.
benchmarkSimple.manualModelHint: Exact model value accepted by the API
benchmarkSimple.rerunUrlRequired: The previous run used a deployment or cloned serving. Enter the URL and any required key for this run.
benchmarkSimple.runnerPlacement: Location of the load runner. This cluster must be able to reach the API URL.
benchmarkSimple.estimatedInputHint: Input length is a word-based estimate and the shared ratio applies to those input units. Actual tokens and throughput use server-reported usage.
benchmarkSimple.rerunDefaults: Saved workload settings loaded. Seed, input generation and runner image use the current defaults.
benchmarkSimple.requestRateHint: Average requests per second. Leave blank to keep sending within the concurrency limit.
benchmarkSimple.sessionRateHint: Average new conversations per second. Turns run sequentially within each conversation. Leave blank to keep starting conversations within the concurrency limit.
benchmarkSimple.ratePositive: Enter a value greater than zero or leave blank.
